payload.reason: The evidence indicates that face tracking, identification, and localization are integrated into a machine learning model that processes multimodal inputs, suggesting that these components are not programmed by hand but rather are part of an automated system.

claims.text: Face tracking, identification, and localization are integrated into a machine learning model that processes multimodal inputs.
The system utilizes algorithms and methods to automate the processing of face data rather than relying on manual programming.
